sources.says: AAJ 1997 summary: IV+ 5.9 95° couloir climbed in steps with 'a little ice protection'; no pitch-by-pitch text retrievable. Entry's own notes: about two pitches, protection available.
Route is a steep gully with hardest ground in a few pitches; no WI5 rating found independently. The entry text itself calls this a near-vertical ice pitch with a belay at its base.
After the M6 notch crack, party traverses into the final couloir of the North Buttress Couloir route; the entry's own notes call it one more steep mixed pitch. Grade not stated by source.
(search snippet only, page 403) NE Face is a technical snow/ice/rock route (Beckey-Rupley 1971) climbing an 'objective ice apron' across crevasses; entry notes say screws needed. Route ice_grade AI3.
Willis Wall is a Grade V face whose upper ice steps beneath the ice cliff are climbed belayed; route ice_grade AI3. No source page confirmed pitch style.

pin_unsure: wa_ultramega_ok / wa_vasiliki_ridge_standard: 'Early Winters Creek crossing' coordinate 48.56803,-120.629805 is ~1.2 mi north of the pullout (48.55/48.549); distMi 0.2/0.3 and elev 4080 look right, so the COORDINATE is wrong, but no source with the true crossing coordinate was found (Mountaineers/SummitPost give none). Suggest moving the pin to the creek just east of the pullout, ~48.550,-120.627 (derived, not sourced), or recompute.

wa_mount_redoubt_south_face / wa_southeast_mox_peak_se_rib: TH pin 49.033,-121.4025 is 3.8 mi straight from Monument 65 though sources put Monument 65 ~1 mi (0.8 h) from the car, and Ouzel is 6.2 mi trail but 8 mi straight from the pin. Monument 65, falls and Ouzel are mutually consistent; the TH pin is the outlier. No source gave the washout coordinate; the Mox route's Monument 65 1.2, Falls 4.5, Ouzel 6.2 are fine.
wa_mount_carrie_se_route: Boston Charlie's Camp 12.8 left alone; one Mountaineers guide says ~14 mi, route text says summit ~13 mi. Unsettled.

wa_lemah_mountain_east_route: three coordinate-less pins (Point 3854 cairn line, Snow gully and moat transition, Southeast ridge notch) - no source for coordinates found. Lemah Creek crossing 6.5 is derived/low.
wa_ragged_ridge: Mesahchie basin 4.4 left (Easy Pass 3.5 + ~1.1 = 4.6, consistent). Summit pins have no distMi; no sourced distances.

wa_lena_lake_to_mt_stone_traverse: Putvin Trail hazard is on the DESCENT (route text: exit via Putvin Trail to a different trailhead), so being stored past the summit (13.3 > 10.8) is correct; its coordinates are near the Lena TH only because the Putvin TH is nearby. No change; exact distance unsourced.
wa_hagan_mountain_south: Hidden Lake (Bacon-Hagan saddle), Hazard pins and the Hagan summit have no distMi; unsourced.
